title: Demo flight
description: The file game/tuning/demo.json: the demo flight the first Play of a page load shows, its script, its coin and its look, read in both run modes by game/app/demo_tuning.py. The file must exist and every field is required: nothing has a default in code. Rules the schema cannot express: coin_step names a step; a standing step holds no keys; coin_type is a pickup (checked by core.demo.start_demo); coin_variant is a variant of coin_type's tuning; caption_role is a screens text role. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/demo.md.

enabled.description: false: no demo; Play starts the run at once.

keys.description: The arrows held through the step. [] for a standing step and an autopilot step.

ticks.description: How long the step lasts, ticks.

caption.description: The caption shown from this step on. null: the last caption stays.

stand.description: true: the ship stands still through the step, as in the respawn wait. A standing step holds no keys and flies nowhere.

pilot_to.description: null, or [x, y] inside the 640 x 480 play area: the autopilot taps the arrows itself to fly to that spot and hover there. A step that flies by the autopilot holds no keys and does not stand.

coin_step.description: Index of the step at whose last tick the ship reaches the coin.

coin_type.description: The drifter type of the coin, a pickup.

coin_variant.description: The coin's variant in its type's tuning.

fade_out_ticks.description: The last ticks of the demo, in which the play area fades to black.

pilot.description: How the autopilot taps the arrows. Speeds px/tick, distances px.

gain.description: Speed wanted per px of distance to the spot. Bigger flies in harder.

max_speed.description: Fastest speed asked for, up or down, px/tick. Sideways 1.5 times this.

band.description: How far the speed may stray from the wanted one before a key goes down or up, px/tick. Bigger gives longer taps and a little more bob.

near_px.description: Sideways distance to the spot within which, with sideways speed under near_speed, no side key is tapped.

look.description: Sizes and timings of the demo's overlay. Colors and the font are the screens' (screens.json).

key_radius.description: A key cap's corner radius, px.

key_bottom.description: Gap from the play area's bottom edge to the bottom row of keys, px.

arrow_size.description: Half the arrow's width on a key cap, px.

key_fade_ticks.description: Ticks a key's glow takes to fill or drain.

press_depth.description: How far a held key sinks, px.

idle_fill_alpha.description: A key cap's fill when not held.

idle_border_alpha.description: A key cap's border when not held.

lit_fill_alpha.description: A key cap's fill when held.

caption_role.description: The screens' text role of the caption: a role name in screens.json fonts.roles.

caption_gap.description: Gap from the caption's bottom to the top row of keys, px.

caption_fade_ticks.description: Ticks a new caption takes to fade in.

caption_rise.description: How far a new caption rises while it fades in, px.

skip_margin.description: Gap from the play area's top and right edges to the skip hint, px.

skip_word.description: The word after the ENTER and SPACE key caps of the skip hint.

fade_in_ticks.description: Ticks the run after the demo takes to fade in from black. 0: no fade.

coin_ring_radius.description: The pulsing ring round the waiting coin: its middle radius, px. 0: no ring.

coin_ring_pulse.description: How far the ring's radius swings either way, px.

coin_ring_alpha.description: The ring's alpha at its brightest.

start_text.description: The word that shows in the last start_ticks, as the run is about to start.

start_role.description: The screens' text role of the start word: a role name in screens.json fonts.roles.

start_ticks.description: The last ticks of the demo in which the start word shows instead of the caption. 0: no start word.

start_pop_ticks.description: Ticks the start word takes to fade in and shrink to its size.

start_scale.description: How big the start word starts, times its size. It shrinks to 1.

start_y.description: The start word's center, px from the play area's top edge.
